verification.validation: Focused SQLite unit and conformance race tests, Linux ARM64 and ARMv7 SDK builds, the concurrent write benchmark, documentation checks and generated package metadata checks.

changes: Add a driver-independent Go sqlitestore for App-owned SQLite databases with a bounded reader pool and an optional independent background pool.
Serialize writes on one connection using BEGIN IMMEDIATE and work-bounded group commit, isolate callbacks with savepoints, and drain accepted work on close.
Reuse the SQLite file layout and maintenance helpers and keep the existing executor release and digests.
